dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you always standing guard here?

dialogues.speaker: Musina
dialogues.text: Of course. As you can see, I am fulfilling our formation's most sacred duty, defending these three square meters of sacred Snezhnayan soil!

dialogues.speaker: Musina
dialogues.text: You won't find me slacking off until a new squad member replaces me... Probably, anyway...
